content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Automated ebook

This is not a workaround—it’s base-layer infrastructure. A sovereign commerce stack is a combination of free and paid tools that enable you to sell digital products directly to customers, regardless of where you’re located. It’s built on open-source and decentralized technologies, ensuring no single platform can shut you down. For example, instead of relying on Gumroad’s 10% fee structure, you use NOWPayments, which charges just 0.5% for crypto transactions. At 100 sales per month on a $97 product, that’s $921 more in your pocket. This stack gives you full data ownership, automatic delivery, and the freedom to operate without geographical or financial barriers.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The core of this system is a combination of hosting, backend logic, storage, and payment processing. Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic is handled by Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which automates order processing and file delivery. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. Payment verification is handled by NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies and fires a webhook the moment payment confirms on-chain. This architecture ensures instant delivery, low fees, and zero reliance on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This stack is designed for digital creators in regions where conventional payment platforms are restricted or unreliable. If you sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, or software and struggle to collect payment, this is for you. It’s also for creators who want to own their infrastructure instead of renting it. By deploying this stack, you eliminate platform fees, avoid geographic restrictions, and retain full control over your business. Whether you’re in Kenya, Pakistan, or Venezuela, this system works because it’s built on globally accessible, decentralized tools.
NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction—19x less than Gumroad’s 10% fee structure.
The Components That Make It Work Together

Each component in this stack serves a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide fast, free hosting. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, automating tasks like order processing and file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data securely, while Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 host your digital files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments, converting USD prices to crypto at transaction time and verifying payments on-chain. These tools integrate seamlessly, creating a fully automated system that requires no manual intervention after deployment.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this stack, start by choosing your hosting and backend tools. If you’re new to coding, Google Apps Script and GitHub Pages are beginner-friendly. For more advanced users, Cloudflare Workers and Supabase offer greater scalability. Next, integrate NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions. Load your products, configure file delivery, and test the entire flow end-to-end. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure—no subscriptions, no platform fees, and lifetime access. For a step-by-step guide, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates, saving you time and ensuring a smooth deployment.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

To sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe, deploy a sovereign commerce stack using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for crypto transactions. This eliminates platform fees and geographic restrictions. For example, NOWPayments charges just 0.5% compared to Gumroad’s 10%, saving you $921 on 100 sales of a $97 product. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all the blueprints and templates you need to get started.
This stack is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and payment rejection are the norm.

If you’re looking to sell notion templates for USDT or Bitcoin, or build a digital download store that accepts only crypto, the principles outlined here apply directly. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) includes everything you need to deploy and scale a sovereign stack, from blueprints to templates. Available for instant download at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html, it’s the fastest way to take control of your digital commerce infrastructure.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your hosting platform: GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 2. Set up backend logic using Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 3. Configure order storage with Supabase or Google Sheets. 4. Upload your digital files to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. 5. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 6. Test the entire flow from payment to file delivery. 7. Deploy your stack and start selling. For a complete guide, download the Complete Builder Kit ($197) from https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this stack if I’m not a developer?
Yes. The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) is designed for non-developers, using GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script. It’s deployed in 48 hours with 3 products loaded and 30-day support.
What cryptocurrencies does NOWPayments support?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, USDT, and stablecoins on low-fee networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay recurring fees after deployment?
No. Once deployed, you own the infrastructure. There are no subscriptions or recurring fees—only a 0.5% transaction fee from NOWPayments.
Can I scale this stack as my business grows?
Yes. The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration and end-to-end testing, ensuring scalability and reliability.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments operates on decentralized blockchain networks, making downtime extremely rare. Even if their service is disrupted, your funds remain secure on-chain.
You own the infrastructure after deployment. No platform can shut you down or change the rules.
